exclusions: Only items tied to a 2026 regular-season home date from p0/homegames-nfl.json were counted. Pages or paths carrying 2025 (for example /gameday/2025/*, /tickets/2025/*, 2025 Salute to Service hometown hero text) were excluded by year in URL, byline date, or body text. Preseason items (August 2026, /preseason_* or /pre/ paths, 'Preseason Week N' guides) were excluded by path and date. Away-game watch parties and off-site fan fests were excluded because they are not on a home date. Rolling next-game pages were tied to a date only when the page body or its section banner named the opponent or kickoff time that matches one home date. Lions specifics: Salute to Service page text is 2025 and Women In Football page is 2024, both excluded; training-camp giveaway pages excluded as preseason; Munich fan fest items excluded as off-site.
notes: All three dated items fall on the one upcoming home game (10/25 vs Packers), because the /game-day/ pages roll forward to the next game. 9/13 and 9/27 promos were overwritten and cannot be recovered. A config would need /game-day/power-hour plus /game-day/entertainment polled weekly in the days before each home game, with the date taken from the section banner (opponent) rather than the page body. Food deals (Deals in the Den) are in images and are every-game.
